pages.title: Ancient YunLai Swordmanship
pages.text: §lMax Level: §r I$(br2)§lApplicable Items: §r Swords$(br2)§lEffect: §r Greatly boosts attack speed, reach, and damage; hits have a high chance to launch a powerful golden sword-qi projectile.$(br2)§lAcquisition: §r Treasure-only: Loot Chests and Villager Trades$(br2)§lConflicts: §r Mutually exclusive with YunLai Swordmanship and other melee damage/growth enchantments.
